purpose: Runtime entry points. All state is observed live — never static files.

principles.no_stale: Parameters not updated in 30 days are flagged stale and fall back to last-known-good.
principles.observed_not_declared: Runtime state is observed via health probes, never written by hand.
principles.feedback_loop: Observation -> Evaluation -> Action -> Proof -> Learning. Mandatory for every component.
principles.single_source: cynic-kernel is the runtime SSOT. Registry files are deprecated in favor of observed state.

degraissage_target: cynic-host (139 pub mod) must be slimmed. Next extractions: observer loops, admission, capacity monitoring must become standalone crates.
feedback: This file is a contract pointer. It does not contain data — only pointers to runtime endpoints and contracts.
